description: This chart compares the perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on three different validation datasets under varying quantization bits. The chart is divided into three sub-charts, labeled (a) WikiText, (b) PTB, and (c) C4, each with a horizontal axis representing quantization bits and labeled with values 3, 4, 8, and 16 in ascending order. The vertical axis represents perplexity, with labels and scales differing across the sub-charts: (a) has a linear scale from 0 to 30 with an interval of 5, (b) has a linear scale from 0 to 400 with an interval of 50, and (c) has a linear scale from 0 to 30 with an interval of 5. Each sub-chart displays grouped bars, with two bars per quantization bit value, colored blue and orange, representing 'Uniform' and 'Ours', respectively. In all sub-charts, the blue bars are consistently taller than the orange bars, with the blue bars ranging from approximately 26 to 29 in (a), 320 to 410 in (b), and 25 to 29 in (c), while the orange bars range from 18 to 22 in (a), 140 to 250 in (b), and 17 to 21 in (c). The bars are grouped by quantization bits, and within each group, 'Uniform' is always to the left of 'Ours'. The quantization bits are in ascending order across the horizontal axis, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
